svg.title: How the DRV8262 swing gate controller fits together
svg.desc: A phone or laptop browser talks HTTP and WebSocket to the ESP32-C3 Wi-Fi bridge, and Home Assistant talks to it through an MQTT broker. The bridge (web dashboard, wireless flasher, MQTT) owns the one UART link to the MSP430F5338 at 115200 8N1. The MSP430 runs the state machine and all safety logic, the motion profile (25kHz PWM) and current and voltage sensing, and works with no network. It reads the limit switches, photo beam and RF remote, drives the DRV8262 H-bridge with PWM on IN1 and IN2, and reads the motor current back through IPROPI. The DRV8262 drives the gate actuator from the 12V battery.
